text:
Devon (AE): Quick handoff for AsteriaCare — signed today. Key facts: Prod start 2025-06-02, initial traffic ~5k req/day, customer wants Private VPC in eu-west-1, SSO via Okta + SCIM, data residency EU, and a dedicated GPU pool (baseline 2xA100 with burst to 4). Trial dataset coming next week. Success metrics: p50 gen <100ms, renewal in ~11 months. Known risk: SAML metadata from their IdP is nonstandard; SCIM provisioning required. Legal redlines are cleared. Action: need CS kickoff + SE for SSO + Support triage for SCIM. CC @Maya, @Sam, @Jordan

Maya (CSM): Thanks Devon — I'll own kickoff. Proposed timeline: pre-kickoff checklist by 2025-03-14, SSO test window 2025-03-20 to 03-22, pilot go-live 2025-04-01. Who is the customer's IT point? Also need SCIM scope (groups vs users). @Sam can you confirm SSO playbook availability?

Sam (SE): I'll run the SSO test. Sam to request IdP metadata and set up a test tenant. FYI we've seen an Okta attribute mapping edge case — will validate. Preparing runbook + sample SCIM config.

Jordan (Support Eng): Heads up — we have an existing issue where SCIM bulk requests fail when group payloads exceed ~10k chars (internal INC-4312). If AsteriaCare has large group exports this will surface. I'll open a priority support ticket and provide a workaround. Need a sample SCIM payload from their side.

Ethan (SRE): Capacity note — dedicated pool of 2xA100s is fine for baseline, but to meet <100ms p50 we should enable prefix/KV cache and q4_0 quantization. Recommend starting with 2 nodes, autoscale to 4, burst policy weekdays 09:00-17:00 CET. I can provision once CS confirms approval and billing tier.

Maya (CSM): Owners & next steps: CSM kickoff owner: Maya; SE (SSO/SCIM): Sam; Support triage: Jordan; Dedicated provisioning: Ethan; Customer contact: Lena (AsteriaCare IT). I'll create calendar invites and the customer playbook entry.

Devon (AE): Lena contact: lena_it@asteriacare.com, +44 7700 123456. They want a one-hour enablement session for 10 engineers and separate API keys per team. Please place them in "Early Access" billing tier for the first 3 months.

Jordan (Support Eng): Opened ticket SUP-8419 (linked to INC-4312). Requesting sample SCIM payload and Okta app config from customer. Will attach workaround; will escalate to eng if reproducible.

Sam (SE): Uploading test instructions and sample payload to shared drive: https://redwood.app/drive/asteriacare-ssotest. Will PR runbook and include step-by-step Okta mapping notes.

Maya (CSM): Action item checklist (tracking in playbook): 1) Sam request metadata from customer (by 2025-03-07) 2) Jordan support ticket & triage (SUP-8419) 3) Ethan to request dedicated capacity (by 2025-03-09) 4) Maya send kickoff invite (by 2025-03-06) 5) Schedule enablement session (by 2025-03-12). I'll keep IT contact and stakeholders copied. :calendar:

Ethan (SRE): I'll provision a staging dedicated pool for SSO tests tomorrow and post test credentials in the playbook.

Jordan (Support Eng): tagging @eng-oncall for visibility — please monitor SUP-8419 in case it escalates.

eng-oncall: acknowledged. We'll monitor SUP-8419 and assign to oncall if it escalates. :eyes:

Devon (AE): Thanks team — happy to join kickoff and support handoff. :thumbsup:

Maya (CSM): Closing thread — I'll post kickoff notes and the playbook link after invites go out. Ping me directly for blockers.
